answer_4.quote: We employ Amazon Mechanical Turk workers. A qualified worker is one who has completed more than 10,000 HITs and has an approval rate greater than 99%.
answer_4.guideline: They are shown only three examples with entailment, neutral and contradiction labels before annotation. For each premise-hypothesis pair, five workers were asked to annotate the entailment relation (entailment, neutral or contradiction) following the guidelines of .
